scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a housing loan and I wanted to check on the status of my application. Could you tell me if it has been approved, denied, or is still pending? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your application for a conventional subordinate lien loan for home improvement was denied.

dialogue.user: I see. Could you tell me the reason for the denial? Also, what was the interest rate that was considered for my application?
dialogue.agent: The loan was denied due to your debt-to-income ratio. The interest rate was not determined because the application was denied.

dialogue.user: I understand. What does my debt-to-income ratio mean for my application? Also, are there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is the percentage of your monthly income that goes toward paying debts. In your case, it was 46%. There are no high-cost or negative amortization flags on your loan.

dialogue.user: I see. Is there anything I can do to improve my chances of getting approved in the future? Also, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: The record does not include underwriting rationale. Your loan has not been sold to another institution because the application was denied.

dialogue.user:
I understand. Thank you for the information. I think that's all I need to know for now.

<Dissatisfied> I'm disappointed that my application was denied, but I appreciate the information provided. I'll work on improving my debt-to-income ratio and try again in the future.
